collection.description: Two teenagers quarrel; one offers an apology mostly to escape a consequence, while the other remains hurt.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (teen1) and (teen2), two teenagers, quarrel; one offers an apology mostly to escape a consequence, while the other remains hurt.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: They accept distance without being called unforgiving.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: They ask for changed behavior rather than more words.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: They admit they are not ready to mean it yet.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The teen repairs a damaged belonging.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A temporary boundary prevents another confrontation.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The pair rebuild a cautious friendship.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They remain civil without becoming friends.
